title: atriplex hastata var. triangularis
intro: Atriplex hastata var. triangularis, commonly known as Triangular Orach, is a plant species of the Amaranthaceae family, characterized by its triangular leaves and edible qualities. The Triangular Orach plant is known to have various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antioxidant, and support digestive health. Therapeutically, the plant is used to treat conditions such as skin issues, wounds, and gastrointestinal disorders due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents found in Triangular Orach include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
